headline.note: Only the letter-evidenced awards move this figure. The flagged tenders keep their published value because their true award value is not established by this archive.

rule.correctionPolicy: Only an award letter may correct an award value. Where a letter states an agreement amount it replaces the published figure and the document SHA-256 is printed. Where no letter exists the value is flagged and NOTHING is substituted: an estimate is not an award value.
rule.name: lakh_denominated_award_value
rule.reason: The portal stores a lakh-denominated figure in a rupee column, so the published award equals the estimate divided by 100,000.
